# Rainmakers

> Rainmakers is an innovation advisor and venture builder & accelerator, active in Milan since 2011 (under the name Nuvolab until 2021). It connects entrepreneurs and startups with people, expertise and opportunities, and it created Italian Rainforest, the map of the Italian innovation ecosystem.

Rainmakers is neither a fund nor just a community: it is a network of entrepreneurs, experts and partners that helps companies grow. Founder: Francesco Inguscio.

## Who it is for
Founders and entrepreneurs of startups, scaleups and SMEs, intrapreneurs and innovation managers. Investors, corporates and innovation professionals are welcome too.

## What Rainmakers does
- Advisory: innovation advisory for companies, institutions and investors (since 2011).
- Investments: investment advisory for VC funds, family offices and corporate VCs.
- Club: entrepreneurs and intrapreneurs (300+) who invest in Tribe startups.
- Lab: marketing, sales, funding, finance, tech, legal and HR "as a service" for startups.
- Tribe: venture builder & accelerator — startups created, co-founded or accelerated (6 exits, significant stakes in 14 startups).
- Community: events, vertical WhatsApp communities and giveback initiatives.

## Rainmakers and Italian Rainforest
Rainmakers is the organisation: people, experience, relationships and community. Italian Rainforest (https://italian-innovation-map.vercel.app/en) is a separate project created by Rainmakers: the map and database of the Italian innovation ecosystem (investors, incubators and accelerators, corporate VC, startup studios, coworking spaces, institutions and other innovation enablers), open data for non-commercial use. WhatsApp communities are where people meet and take part.

## Track record
- Tribe (startups): https://www.rainmakers.it/en#tribe
- Innovation advisory projects (28 documented, e.g. Le Village by Crédit Agricole, Assolombarda, University of Milano-Bicocca, Intesa Sanpaolo, 360 Capital Partners): https://www.rainmakers.it/en#advisory
